revision_requests.text: In a real browser the stylesheets do not load. Console: 'Refused to execute a script because its hash, its nonce, or unsafe-inline does not appear in the script-src directive of the Content Security Policy (localhost, line 3216)'. Check that the CSP is set correctly and fix the stylesheet loading.
revision_requests.resolution: Root cause: Astro 7 applied security.csp under astro dev, blocking Vite's dev-only inline script and injected styles. Fix fix/dev-csp (merge 5b4f849): an inline integration sets security.csp=false only when Astro's command is 'dev'. Production _headers.json byte-identical across build variants; dev verified in a real browser (styles load, no CSP errors). Review APPROVED round 2.

revision_requests.text: Layout is hardcoded to the 1440/1280 px design widths instead of being fluid: section backgrounds do not stretch edge to edge on wide screens and content is not centred with a max-width container (mx-auto); elements overflow (e.g. Contact form inputs extend past their card). Responsive design is not done: at phone widths (320-414 px) headings, text, and buttons overflow and are cut off (e.g. empty CTA pill on Contact). Evidence: user screenshots of the deployed site at ~2000 px and 320/414 px.
revision_requests.resolution: Root cause: Meridian --container-full: 1440px in Tailwind's --container-* namespace made w-full/max-w-full compile to 1440px. Fix fix/fluid-layout (merge 15097fc): token moved to :root; every band full-bleed with shared centred container (mx-auto, max-w-wide at xl, max-w-narrow below); tables/header/hero/turnstile fixed at narrow widths; break-word; guard tests for utility collisions and per-breakpoint fixed widths (703 tests). Verified: orchestrator real-browser sweep 320-2560 px (no overflow, full-bleed bands, centred content, inputs inside card); developer WebKit sweep 31 routes x 19 widths = 589/589 pass. Review APPROVED round 2.
